input.reason: Two invoices for job HC-14-310; one has a different payee and exceeds the approved £210 quote – possible duplicate billing / payment diversion
input.summary: 19 Coppice Road, Ludlow Heath, ZZ5 7ZZ. Job HC-14-310: landlord Ms Ferrer approved Thermo-Serve Ltd to replace immersion thermostat/element, quote £210 (22/09/2026). Work done 25/09, tenant confirmed hot water back. On 06/10 an email from the Thermo-Serve address on file ("Invoice attached, please pay") carried two invoices: TS-0881 Thermo-Serve Ltd, £175 + £35 VAT = £210 (matches approval); TS-0882 payee "H&S Domestic Services", £270 + £54 VAT = £324, incl. "extra labour (2h)", same job ref, consecutive number, contractor of record still Thermo-Serve. Landlord pays invoices herself once the agency has checked them.
input.checked: CRM ticket 66: no events, approvals, contacts' details or attachments on file beyond the case description. Compared both invoice lines against the approval in the office notes: TS-0881 matches contractor, amount and scope; TS-0882 differs in payee (not the contractor of record), amount (+£114 over approval) and scope (unapproved extra labour). No record of any variation request or landlord approval for extra labour. No tenant complaint; no prior issues with Thermo-Serve in 3 years.
input.uncertain: Whether TS-0882 is a genuine Thermo-Serve invoice, a subcontractor invoice, an error, or a fraud/compromised-mailbox attempt; whether both were meant to be paid or one replaces the other; whether TS-0881 is still valid. Landlord, tenant and contractor contact details are not visible in the CRM. Original email/PDFs not visible as attachments.
input.recommendation: Do not pass either invoice to the landlord for payment yet. Ops to call Thermo-Serve on the phone number already on file (not any number in the invoice email) to confirm which invoice is theirs and whether H&S Domestic Services has any connection. If TS-0881 (£210) is confirmed as the sole invoice, forward it to Ms Ferrer as checked and void TS-0882. If extra labour is genuinely claimed, it needs the landlord's separate approval with justification, payable only to the contractor of record. If Thermo-Serve doesn't recognise TS-0882, treat as attempted fraud: warn the landlord, and advise Thermo-Serve their email may be compromised.

fact.value: true - landlord pays invoices herself after agency checks them against her approval; agency does not pay contractors on this account
Landlord approved Thermo-Serve Ltd to replace immersion thermostat/element, quote £210 (2026-09-22); work reported complete 2026-09-25

data.reasoning: Two invoices share the same job reference but tell different stories - TS-0881 matches the approved quote and contractor, while TS-0882 has a different payee and an unapproved extra charge, which looks like a possible duplicate or fraud attempt. I'm leaning toward escalating this rather than forwarding either one, since even the matching invoice should be verified directly with Thermo-Serve before anything gets paid.

result.summary: Two invoices came in for job HC-14-310. TS-0881 (Thermo-Serve Ltd, £210) matches the approved quote and the contractor. TS-0882 (H&S Domestic Services, £324, includes extra labour) has a different payee from the contractor of record, is £114 over the approval and covers work nobody approved. That pattern could be duplicate billing or an attempt to redirect payment. Neither invoice has been passed to the landlord. The case has gone to a human (high priority) to check with Thermo-Serve by phone first.

judgement.why_this_decision: The rules say never to forward or approve an invoice that doesn't match the approved quote or the contractor on the job. TS-0882 doesn't match on payee, amount or scope. Both invoices arrived together from one email address, with the same job ref and consecutive numbers, so even TS-0881 can't safely be marked as checked until Thermo-Serve confirms which invoice is theirs. A possible payment diversion needs agency judgement.

alternatives_considered.option: Forward TS-0881 to the landlord as checked and reject TS-0882
alternatives_considered.why_not: Both came in one email with consecutive numbers, which suggests a compromised mailbox or a billing error. We should confirm with the contractor before the landlord pays anything. Also, no contact details are on file.

alternatives_considered.option: Ask the landlord to approve the extra £114
alternatives_considered.why_not: The payee isn't the contractor of record and there's no evidence the extra labour happened. It must be verified first.
The email channel itself may be compromised, so a phone call to the number on file is safer. There's also no contractor on the ticket and no contact details.

checks_performed: Loaded ticket 66: no events, approvals, contacts or attachments
Checked both invoices against the approval in the office notes (Thermo-Serve, £210, thermostat and element)
Checked payee against contractor of record
Looked for any approved variation or extra labour: none
Safety: hot water restored and no complaint from the tenant
assumptions: The office notes in the case description accurately record the landlord's approval and that the work was completed

result.situation: The immersion thermostat and element repair at 19 Coppice Road is done and was approved at £210 with Thermo-Serve Ltd. Two invoices were then received, and one has a different payee and a higher amount. The landlord pays invoices herself once the agency has checked them.

actions_taken.result: Nothing on file beyond the description: no events, contacts or approvals

actions_taken.description: Recorded on the landlord's profile that she pays contractors directly after the agency checks invoices
Recorded the HC-14-310 approval (£210, Thermo-Serve) on the property
Raised the invoice mismatch and possible payment diversion with ops, high priority

approvals.status: granted (historical, per office notes): Thermo-Serve, £210. The extra £114 has not been approved

escalation.reason: Invoice payee and amount don't match the approved quote or contractor of record; possible fraud or duplicate billing
escalation.handover_summary: HC-14-310: £210 approved for Thermo-Serve. Invoices received: TS-0881 Thermo-Serve £210 (matches) and TS-0882 H&S Domestic Services £324 including 2h extra labour (doesn't match). Both came from the Thermo-Serve email address. Nothing has been sent to the landlord.
escalation.recommendation: Phone Thermo-Serve on the number already on file. If only TS-0881 is theirs, forward £210 to Ms Ferrer as checked and void TS-0882. Any extra labour needs separate landlord approval and must be payable to the contractor of record. If they don't recognise TS-0882, warn the landlord and the contractor about possible email compromise.
